claims.claim: Andy Burnham told Labour’s conference in Liverpool on Tuesday that the Conservative Brexit settlement had done more harm than good and said he would set out relationship options at a UK-EU summit later this year.
claims.episode_span: the Brexit settlement struck by the Conservatives had done “more harm than good”
claims.source_title: UK’s Burnham says he’ll consider push to rejoin EU
claims.supporting_quote: Burnham told the governing Labour Party’s annual conference in Liverpool Tuesday that the Brexit settlement struck by the Conservatives had done “more harm than good” and said he would spell out “what I believe the different options are for Britain’s long-term relationship with our European partners” at a U.K.–EU summit later this year.

claims.claim: In a BBC interview broadcast Wednesday, Burnham said Britain could look at a customs union, the single market, or go all the way.
claims.episode_span: or we could go all the way
claims.source_title: UK’s Burnham says he’ll consider push to rejoin EU
claims.supporting_quote: In a BBC interview , broadcast Wednesday, Burnham said: “We could look at what [former Chancellor] George Osborne has said about a customs union, we could look at what the Liberal Democrats said at their conference about the single market, or we could go all the way.”

claims.claim: Burnham’s government will stick before a general election to Starmer’s promise not to rejoin the single market or customs union.
claims.episode_span: will stick, before a general election, to predecessor Keir Starmer’s promise
claims.source_title: UK’s Burnham says he’ll consider push to rejoin EU
claims.supporting_quote: Burnham’s Labour predecessor, Keir Starmer, had promised not to rejoin the EU’s single market or customs union. Burnham’s government will stick to that position before a general election

claims.claim: The Conservatives accuse Burnham of trying to reopen old wounds by restarting the battles of the Brexit years.
claims.episode_span: reopen old wounds by restarting the battles of the Brexit years
claims.source_title: Move to rejoin EU among options for UK, says Burnham
claims.supporting_quote: The move could set up a huge dividing line at the next general election, with the Conservatives accusing him of trying to "reopen old wounds by restarting the battles of the Brexit years".

claims.claim: As a Makerfield by-election candidate, Burnham said he was not proposing that the UK consider rejoining the EU.
claims.episode_span: not proposing that the UK considers rejoining the EU
claims.source_title: Move to rejoin EU among options for UK, says Burnham
claims.supporting_quote: As a candidate in the Makerfield by-election that propelled his return to Parliament, he had promised not to "re-run" Brexit arguments and said he was "not proposing that the UK considers rejoining the EU".

claims.claim: At least three people, including a child, died in Russian strikes on Kyiv and surrounding regions overnight to Wednesday, officials said, and several people were wounded.
claims.episode_span: At least three people, including a child, died overnight into Wednesday
claims.source_title: Live: Several people killed as Russia launches new round of strikes on Kyiv
claims.supporting_quote: At least three people, including a child, have died after Russia launched another round of strikes on Kyiv and its surrounding regions overnight to Wednesday, officials said. Several people were also wounded in the attacks.

claims.claim: Airports in Lublin and Rzeszow were briefly shut over military aviation activity during Russian attacks on Ukraine.
claims.episode_span: airports in Lublin and Rzeszow were briefly shut
claims.source_title: Live: Several people killed as Russia launches new round of strikes on Kyiv
claims.supporting_quote: In Poland, two airports, in Lublin and Rzeszow, were briefly shut over “military aviation activity” during Russian attacks on Ukraine.

claims.claim: Europe’s data centers used 20.7 terawatt-hours of electricity and more than 8 million cubic meters of water in 2025, up 26 percent and 52 percent from 2024.
claims.source_title: EU accused of hiding environmental impact of data centers
claims.supporting_quote: According to the Commission's figures, Europe’s data centers used 20.7 terawatt-hours of electricity — about as much electricity as the entire nation of Croatia consumes — and more than 8 million cubic meters of water in 2025. That's a 26% increase in electricity use and 52% in water use from 2024.

claims.claim: Angela Eagle will pledge half a million trees in England over three years inside a £79 million package, with £53 million for planting and £26 million for local nature recovery strategies.
claims.episode_span: £79 million package of £53 million for planting and £26 million
claims.source_title: Half a million trees to be planted in England in three years, says government
claims.supporting_quote: The £79m package, to be set out in Eagle’s speech to the Labour party conference in Liverpool, will include £53m for tree-planting and £26m for “local nature recovery strategies”.

claims.claim: A record 23 zettajoules of heat entered the world’s seas last year, almost 40 times humanity’s energy use that year, and Europe is heating twice as fast as the global average.
claims.episode_span: a record 23 zettajoules of heat entered the world’s seas last year
claims.source_title: World’s seas heated by a record 23 zettajoules last year
claims.supporting_quote: A record-breaking 23 zettajoules of heat was sunk into the world’s seas last year, leaving ocean waters hotter, higher and less hospitable, a report has found.

claims.claim: Researchers examined 102 documented deaths and 214 fragmentary disappearance reports linked to the Polish-Belarusian border, and Poland’s Interior Ministry says the report distorts the picture.
claims.source_title: Poland-Belarus Borderlands: How a Forest Is Made Lethal
claims.supporting_quote: Drawing on testimonies, medical data, field research, maps and geostatistical analysis, the researchers examined 102 documented deaths linked to the Polish-Belarusian border area and 214 fragmentary reports of potential disappearances.
